TEXT.English: Hi. I'm [OUR_NAME], ruler of [OUR_EMPIRE]. I hope we can work peacefully together in a mutual parternship. Right, [CT_NAME]?
I thought you wanted to be friends with me. I guess that I was wrong...
I am NOT interested in making up with you right now. Go away!
Yes, [CT_NAME], I agree that we have no reason to fight. Thank you!
Hey there! Do you need something?
What could it possibly be now? This better be a good use of my time!
Hahaha! Don't get on my bad side anymore, [CT_NAME]. You wouldn't like the results... Does not my stockpile of nuclear weapons scare you, hmm?
Hello! I would like you to provide me this small tribute, please.
Hey there, friend! I need to borrow this from you. It's for my most recent plan... Will you accept my request?
Giving me this tribute will show me that I can trust you. Are you willing to work with me?
Giving me this gift will show me that you like me as a friend. Are you willing to accept my small request?
Hello! I would like you to provide me this small gift, please.
Greetings! I would like you to provide me a little 'donation', please.
Accepting this tribute will show me that I can trust you, [CT_NAME]. Are you willing to work with me?
[CT_NAME], let's work together! I think cooperation is a great idea, do you agree? Will you take this as proof of my trustworthiness?
I think accepting this trade offer is a good idea, [CT_NAME]... I'm ready to help you with whatever you need, of course! My friend, here is your tribute to celebrate our friendship!
Alright, let's see if THIS deal is acceptable to you, [CT_NAME]. How about it?
I'm ready to discuss the terms of a peace treaty, [CT_NAME]. Here's what I have in mind. How much is stopping our conflict worth to you?
I'd like to make a deal with you, [CT_NAME]! How much are you willing to pay for this?
I don't want to be a party to this deal anymore, [CT_NAME]. Not unless you can offer me something better, of course...

I thought you were my friend, [CT_NAME]! After recent events, I can no longer ignore your dishonesty! I am so very disappointed in you... It's time we confronted this problem, right now! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
